columns.description: The columns, left to right; one per column of `range`.

formula.description: Calculated-column formula text, without a leading `=`. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

name.description: Column name. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

totals.description: What the totals row shows for this column. Custom: the formula in `totals_label`.

totals_label.description: Totals-row label (a text) or, with `totals` = Custom, the formula text. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

items.description: [column_offset, criterion]: column_offset is the zero-based column within the filtered range (0 = its first column).

filter_button.description: The header cells show filter buttons.

header_row.description: The first row of `range` holds the column names.

id.description: Object id, unique among the objects of the workbook.

name.description: Table name, used in structured references (`Sales[Amount]`). Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

range.description: The whole table, header and totals rows included.

style.description: Table style name, e.g. `TableStyleMedium2`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

totals_row.description: The last row of `range` is a totals row.

uid.description: The sheet's stable identity within the document, 1..4294967295. It never changes when the sheet is renamed or moved, and it is the number in this node's id (`sheet-<uid>`) and in the ids of the nodes that belong to it.

items.description: One data validation: what may be typed into its cells.

error_message.description: Text of the alert shown for an invalid entry. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

error_style.description: Stop: the entry is refused. Warning / Information: it may be kept.

error_title.description: Title of the alert shown for an invalid entry. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

f1.description: First operand as formula text. For List: either a quoted literal list `"a,b,c"` or a range with a leading `=`, e.g. `=$A$1:$A$5`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

f2.description: Second operand, used by Between and NotBetween. `null` when absent. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader never resolves it as a path or address.

in_cell_dropdown.description: List: the cell shows a dropdown.

input_message.description: Message shown when the cell is selected. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

input_title.description: Title of the message shown when the cell is selected. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

kind.description: What is checked. Any: nothing. Whole / Decimal / Date / Time / TextLength: the value against `f1` (and `f2`) with `op`. List: the value must be one of a list. Custom: the formula `f1` must be true.

op.description: The comparison (ignored by Any, List and Custom).

view_active.description: The selected cell when the sheet was last saved.

view_top_left.description: The first visible cell of the scrolling area when the sheet was last saved.

visibility.description: Visible, Hidden (can be unhidden in the user interface) or VeryHidden (cannot).

title: core.sheet.sheet - one sheet: name, geometry, view and attached features
